description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `AbstractMqttConsumerActor`, which serves as a base for MQTT consumer actors tailored for HiveMQ clients. It handles receiving MQTT messages, extracting headers and payloads, transforming messages into external representations, and managing acknowledgments and message flow in a messaging system. The class is parameterized by the message type `P` and manages MQTT-specific headers, payload extraction, and message processing logic.

classes.name: AbstractMqttConsumerActor
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for MQTT consumer actors for HiveMQ, encapsulating common MQTT message processing functionalities such as header extraction, payload handling, message transformation, and acknowledgment management.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the specific class type of the MQTT publish message handled by the subclass.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromMqttMessage
methods.description: Creates and returns a map of MQTT headers from the given message, including topic, QoS, and retain flag.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the MQTT payload as an Optional ByteBuffer from the message.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the MQTT topic from the message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the QoS level from the message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the message has the retain flag set.

methods.name: sendPubAck
methods.description: Abstract method to acknowledge the message, typically by sending a PUBACK.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, including processing MQTT messages, handling address status retrieval, and logging unhandled messages.

methods.name: handleMqttMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming MQTT message, converting it to an external message and forwarding it for further processing.

methods.name: hiveToExternalMessage
methods.description: Converts an MQTT message into an external message object, extracting payload, headers, and applying mappings.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Handles acknowledging a message, such as sending a PUBACK, with error handling for acknowledgment failures.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rehandles message rejection, possibly triggering redelivery or acknowledgment based on configuration.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the actor is operating in dry run mode, which would drop messages instead of processing.
